fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-06-11 (evening, 17:00): The complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 6,000) after boarding a crowded bus near Oviya Colony Railway Station Road. Gayathri Krishnan approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000387. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-58-ZZ-1035. The complaint mentions Hariharan Subramani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000044, in connection with the events.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, evening, bus, suspect, vehicle observation, mobile number, railway station road
